introMessage.author: visitor
introMessage.text: Okay Moritz, I recognize myself in that. Those are exactly the problems I have. I just have one question:

messages.author: owner
highlights: web design with real software development
messages.text: Absolutely fair question. I combine web design with real software development. So I look at more than how your website looks. I also make sure it is built properly under the hood.

messages.author: visitor
messages.text: And what does that mean for me in concrete terms?

messages.author: owner
highlights: Custom design instead of a site builder
messages.text: Custom design instead of a site builder. Plus fast load times and a website that is built cleanly and can grow with your business.

messages.author: visitor
messages.text: And what is it like working together?

messages.author: owner
messages.text: You work directly with me. No project managers and no handoffs through a team. I usually get back to you within 24 hours and stay your point of contact after launch.
